plugins.name: demand-insight
plugins.description: Use-case-driven demand forecasting & data analysis for Claude Code. Runs an 8-step iterative loop (hearing → EDA → classification → features → modeling → error analysis → report) with data-leakage prevention, baseline-first adoption, Walk-Forward validation, asymmetric business cost, and Excel reporting — then generates a production implementation (code + tests + deploy).

skills.name: demand-insight-classification
skills.description: Use this skill for Steps 2–3 of demand-insight — the core series classification and per-segment spec. Computes the 4 axes (volume/ADI/CV²/trend), assigns SBC quadrants (Smooth/Erratic/Intermittent/Lumpy), builds hierarchical segments (~8–12), optionally runs ML clustering (k-means / shape / PCA) and compares it against the rule-based result, then proposes a per-segment forecast unit & horizon (lead-time aware). Thresholds are presented as starting points; the user decides. Use after EDA, or to re-classify on pattern change / new stores.
headings: 4軸 → SBC → 階層セグメント
ルールベース（ADI×CV² 4象限 + 推奨モデル系統）
列構成からの直接指定も可:
Step 3 — セグメント別 予測単位/ホライズン（要件 §6.4）
推奨モデル（recommended_models）— 象限から自動
skills.description_zh: 作为需求预测第2至3步，计算量、ADI、CV²与趋势，划分SBC需求象限和层级细分，可比较机器聚类与规则，并按提前期建议预测单元和时域；阈值由用户确定。

skills.name: demand-insight-eda
skills.description: Use this skill for Step 1 of demand-insight — data understanding, preprocessing, and quality checks. Runs missing-value pattern analysis (time-aware interpolation), outlier detection (3σ residual → is_event flag, not deletion), STL/MSTL decomposition, ACF/PACF, ADF stationarity, and change-point detection. Outputs an EDA report and merges a summary into state.json for downstream classification. Use after the H1–H8 hearing or when data is refreshed.
headings: or: python templates/eda.py --data data/sales.csv --date-col date --target-col qty --id-cols store_id,sku_id
skills.description_zh: 作为需求预测第1步开展理解、预处理与质量检查，分析缺失、残差异常事件标记、分解、相关、平稳性与变点，输出EDA报告并更新状态，不直接删除异常。

skills.name: demand-insight-evaluation
skills.description: Use this skill for Steps 6 & 8 of demand-insight — error analysis, business-KPI translation, and the Excel report. Computes accuracy metrics (MAE/RMSE/MAPE/MASE/WMAPE), fulfillment metrics (stockout/overstock), asymmetric business cost, probabilistic quality (Pinball/CRPS, interval coverage), detects systematic bias (by weekday/period/segment), updates hypotheses, recommends next_action (decision.json), optionally reconciles hierarchies (MinTrace), and emits a function-first Excel (.xlsx) report. Use after each modeling iteration, or to produce the final report.
headings: demand-insight-evaluation (Step 6+8: 誤差分析 + レポート)
誤差分析（Step6）→ フィードバック
skills.description_zh: 作为需求预测评估与报告阶段，计算准确度、缺货过量、非对称成本、概率质量及偏差，更新假设与下一步，可做层级协调并生成以功能为主的Excel报告。

skills.name: demand-insight-features
skills.description: Use this skill for Step 4 of demand-insight — building forecast features with strict data-leakage prevention. Generates calendar, cyclical (sin/cos), holiday (incl. pre/post), lag, rolling, and exogenous features, enforcing shift(1) on all target-derived features and the horizon-availability constraint (lags < h are future information for Direct forecasting). Outputs feature_plan.json and a Walk-Forward-safe features table. Use after classification, or when error analysis calls for new explanatory power.
headings: or with horizon: python templates/features.py --data data/sales.csv --date-col date --target-col qty --id-cols store_id,sku_id --horizon 7
skills.description_zh: 为需求预测构建日历、周期、节假日、滞后、滚动与外生特征，严格防泄漏，目标衍生特征shift(1)，遵守预测时域可得性，输出特征计划与前滚安全数据。

skills.name: demand-insight-modeling
skills.description: Use this skill for Steps 5 & 7 of demand-insight — build, backtest, and interpret per-segment models. First builds Naive/Seasonal-Naive/MA/SES baselines via StatsForecast, then applies the segment-appropriate advanced model (LightGBM/Croston/SBA/TSB) with skforecast, runs Walk-Forward Validation with bootstrapped prediction intervals (lead-time gap), and extracts feature importance / SHAP. Adopts an advanced model only if it beats baseline. Use after feature engineering, after a G1 model-family switch, or to measure baselines alone.
headings: CRITICAL — ベースライン先行 & Walk-Forward（要件 §1.2 / §1.3）
系統選択（分類結果に従う / モデルレジストリ `templates/models.py`）
skills.description_zh: 按需求细分建立朴素等基线及LightGBM、Croston、SBA或TSB模型，执行带提前期间隔的前滚验证和自助预测区间，解释特征与SHAP，仅采用优于基线的高级模型。

skills.name: demand-insight-productionize
skills.description: Use this skill once a model has been accepted (acceptance criteria met / next_action=accept) to generate a production implementation — preprocessing, feature building (leakage-safe), training, batch prediction with intervals, a pytest suite (leakage + backtest reproducibility), and deployment config. Copies and parameterizes the templates into the user's project src/ and tests/. Use when the user says "productionize", "generate production code", "make it deployable", or after the loop accepts a model.
headings: 生成物（user プロジェクトの `project/` 配下に出力）
CRITICAL（生成コードが守る不変条件）
skills.description_zh: 在需求预测模型通过验收后生成生产预处理、无泄漏特征、训练、带区间批量预测、泄漏与回测可复现测试及部署配置，参数化模板到项目。

skills.name: demand-insight
skills.description: Use this skill to start or coordinate a use-case-driven demand-forecasting & data-analysis project — running the 8-step iterative loop (hearing → EDA → classification → segment spec → features → modeling → error analysis → report). It conducts the H1–H8 runtime hearing, detects the data pattern (P1/P2/P3) from column structure, initializes input.json/state.json, routes to the stage skills, applies acceptance criteria, and decides the next action. Use when the user says "start demand forecasting", "improve forecast accuracy", "run the whole loop", or invokes /demand-insight.
headings: 1) input.json を作る（hearing 結果を反映）  2) state.json を初期化
skills.description_zh: 启动或协调需求预测八步循环，访谈业务、识别数据模式、初始化输入状态，再组织EDA、分类、细分、特征、建模、误差与报告，依据验收决定下一步。
